cond_0001.intro: Reporting directly to the [Company name masked] Director Advanced Manufacturing Machining, the Advanced Manufacturing Machining Engineer is responsible for executing the manufacturing roadmap for optimizing machining processes, proper use of the equipment, design specifications, setup reviews, and new control strategies. AMME is responsible to lead and ensure that new equipment purchases are specified, sourced, qualified, and properly transitioned into mass production, meeting [Company name masked] and customer requirements and timing.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Support and partner with OpCo's for improving OEE through initiatives such as SMED, TPM, etc. For new and existing equipment.
Work on [Company name masked] corporate strategy to work with OpCo's to drive productivity by internalizing spend (Buy2Make) on new capex and on existing equipment by maximizing machine utilization.
Lead SMED Events - Lead Site CNC technology Assessments – Project Manage Site improvement activities
Support and partner with OpCo's to support on maturity journey for Machining Excellence Playbook. Provide technical development and deployment for new technologies related to machining to drive productivity improvements.
Drive and support machining strategy on productivity improvement by maximizing asset utilization.
Assist in the evolution of the equipment and performs acceptance evaluation accordingly
Identify, recommend, procure, and install machine shop equipment as well as ensure all equipment is thoroughly maintained and calibrated
Support work force utilization, space requirements, workflow and designs layout of equipment and workspace for maximum efficiency.
Continuously improve, provide recommendation on upgrade of equipment to maximize asset utilization.
Interface with tooling supplier to ensure use of proper tooling for production. Work with suppliers to develop better cutting tools for specific PM applications.
Develop machining capability in-house while making changes to enhance the machine functionality.
Identify, develop, and deploy new machining methods (or refine existing) to improve quality, reduce cost, and optimize build schedule
Utilize lean manufacturing methodology for process development and problem solving
Perform root cause analyses when non-conformances are identified and deploy corrective actions
Helping and supporting manufacturing, to achieve safety, quality, efficiency and throughput goals, identifying opportunities to improve.
Apply Project Management skills & tools to lead and support capital equipment/improvement projects.
Investigate equipment performance and identify any problems for corrective actions and solutions.
Writes/revises User Requirement Specs, Functional Requirement, Design Specs, Qualifications, etc.
Supports Factory and Site Acceptance Tests, Machinability Studies, and validation protocols.
Responsible for review and approve PFMEA, DFMEA, PPAPs, and Standard Operating Procedures SOP and ensure that manufacturing and operations comply with.
Utilize continuous improvement methodology to improve internal processes.
Must be able to interact constructively across the whole organization to identify issues and implement improvements.
Hands-on support of new product and new process launch.
Must be able to handle multiple projects and multiple priorities simultaneously.
Ability to perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in mechanical, electrical or manufacturing engineering, industrial technology, or equivalent mix of education and experience.
Minimum five (5) years' experience of manufacturing engineering directly working with machining processes.
Experience setting up and operating state of the art machining equipment
Extensive experience in machining and maintenance.
Well versed in standard machine shop manufacturing processes and set ups
Strong commitment to proper safety precautions in design and practice
Strong understanding of Lean concepts.
Ability to multi-task and perform in a dynamic environment
Demonstrated experience in successfully achieving machining startups.
Proven experience developing/starting new manufacturing processes
Demonstrated experience improving productivity by machining optimization
Demonstrated experience improving OEE. And proven reduction in unplanned maintenance hours
Preferred Requirements
Strong experience with SolidWorks or another mechanical CAD system
Highly experienced with variety of precision conventional and advance metrology systems (photogrammetry, CMMs, 3D imaging)
Excellent interpersonal and influencing skills to interact with other departments.
Strong sense of urgency, accountability and highly objective oriented
Highly organized and efficient in approaching tasks, a self-starter with the ability to problem solve proactively
Clear, concise, and articulate communication skills - verbal, written and listening
Strong team player, work ethic and commitment to win right
Strong analytical skills, ability to think big, act small and scale fast
Demonstrated experience utilizing Advanced Product Quality Planning Methodology and the integrated product and process development techniques within it. (E.g., Process Flow Diagrams, PFMEA, Control Plans, I/PPAP, Standard Work).
Proven success managing medium and large-scale projects from concept development through successful implementation.

cond_0053.responsibilities:
Support and partner with OpCo's for improving OEE through initiatives such as SMED, TPM, etc. For new and existing equipment.

Direct workforce utilization, space requirements, workflow, and layout of equipment and workspace for maximum efficiency.
Continuously improve and determine upgrade recommendations for equipment to maximize asset utilization.
Lead coordination with tooling suppliers to ensure use of proper tooling for production. Work with suppliers to develop better cutting tools for specific PM applications.
Build machining capability in-house while making changes to enhance machine functionality.
Identify, develop, and deploy new machining methods (or refine existing) to improve quality, reduce cost, and optimize build schedule.
Apply lean manufacturing methodology for process development and problem solving.
Execute root cause analyses when non-conformances are identified and deploy corrective actions.
Drive manufacturing performance to achieve safety, quality, efficiency, and throughput goals, identifying opportunities to improve.
Apply Project Management skills and tools to lead and deliver capital equipment/improvement projects.
Investigate equipment performance and determine corrective actions and solutions for identified problems.
Write/revise User Requirement Specs, Functional Requirements, Design Specs, Qualifications, etc.
Lead Factory and Site Acceptance Tests, Machinability Studies, and validation protocols.
Review and approve PFMEA, DFMEA, PPAPs, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) and ensure that manufacturing and operations comply with them.
Apply continuous improvement methodology to improve internal processes.
Engage constructively across the whole organization to identify issues and implement improvements.
Take ownership of new product and new process launch.
Manage multiple projects and multiple priorities simultaneously.
[Location masked] travel 40-50% may be required.
Ability to perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0053.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in mechanical, electrical or manufacturing engineering, industrial technology, or equivalent mix of education and experience.
Minimum five (5) years' experience of manufacturing engineering directly working with machining processes.
Experience setting up and operating state of the art machining equipment.
Extensive experience in machining and maintenance.
Well versed in standard machine shop manufacturing processes and set ups.
Strong experience with SolidWorks or another mechanical CAD system.
Highly experienced with variety of precision conventional and advanced metrology systems (photogrammetry, CMMs, 3D imaging).
Strong commitment to proper safety precautions in design and practice.
Strong understanding of Lean concepts.
Excellent interpersonal and influencing skills to interact with other departments.

Strong sense of urgency, accountability and highly objective oriented.
Highly organized and efficient in approaching tasks, a self-starter with the ability to problem solve proactively.
Clear, concise, and articulate communication skills - verbal, written and listening.
Strong team player, work ethic and commitment to win right.
Strong analytical skills, ability to think big, act small and scale fast.
Demonstrated experience in successfully achieving machining startups.
Proven experience developing/starting new manufacturing processes.
Demonstrated experience improving productivity by machining optimization.
Demonstrated experience improving OEE and proven reduction in unplanned maintenance hours.
Demonstrated experience utilizing Advanced Product Quality Planning Methodology and the integrated product and process development techniques within it (e.g., Process Flow Diagrams, PFMEA, Control Plans, I/PPAP, Standard Work).

cond_0100.intro: We are looking for an Advanced Manufacturing Machining Engineer to join our team.
cond_0100.responsibilities:
Support and partner with OpCo's for improving OEE through initiatives such as SMED, TPM, etc. For new and existing equipment.
Work on corporate strategy to work with OpCo's to drive productivity by internalizing spend (Buy2Make) on new capex and on existing equipment by maximizing machine utilization.
Lead SMED Events - Lead Site CNC technology Assessments – Project Manage Site improvement activities
Support and partner with OpCo's to support on maturity journey for Machining Excellence Playbook. Provide technical development and deployment for new technologies related to machining to drive productivity improvements.
Drive and support machining strategy on productivity improvement by maximizing asset utilization.
Assist in the evolution of the equipment and performs acceptance evaluation accordingly
Identify, recommend, procure, and install machine shop equipment as well as ensure all equipment is thoroughly maintained and calibrated
Support work force utilization, space requirements, workflow and designs layout of equipment and workspace for maximum efficiency.
Continuously improve, provide recommendation on upgrade of equipment to maximize asset utilization.
Interface with tooling supplier to ensure use of proper tooling for production. Work with suppliers to develop better cutting tools for specific PM applications.
Develop machining capability in-house while making changes to enhance the machine functionality.
Identify, develop, and deploy new machining methods (or refine existing) to improve quality, reduce cost, and optimize build schedule
Utilize lean manufacturing methodology for process development and problem solving
Perform root cause analyses when non-conformances are identified and deploy corrective actions
Helping and supporting manufacturing, to achieve safety, quality, efficiency and throughput goals, identifying opportunities to improve.
Apply Project Management skills & tools to lead and support capital equipment/improvement projects.
Investigate equipment performance and identify any problems for corrective actions and solutions.
Writes/revises User Requirement Specs, Functional Requirement, Design Specs, Qualifications, etc.
Supports Factory and Site Acceptance Tests, Machinability Studies, and validation protocols.
Responsible for review and approve PFMEA, DFMEA, PPAPs, and Standard Operating Procedures SOP and ensure that manufacturing and operations comply with.
Utilize continuous improvement methodology to improve internal processes.
Must be able to interact constructively across the whole organization to identify issues and implement improvements.
Hands-on support of new product and new process launch.
Must be able to handle multiple projects and multiple priorities simultaneously.
Ability to perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0100.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in mechanical, electrical or manufacturing engineering, industrial technology, or equivalent mix or education and experience.
Minimum five (5) years' experience of manufacturing engineering directly working with machining processes.
Experience setting up and operating state of the art machining equipment
Extensive experience in machining and maintenance.
Well versed in standard machine shop manufacturing processes and set ups
Strong experience with SolidWorks or another mechanical CAD system
Highly experienced with variety of precision conventional and advance metrology systems (photogrammetry, CMMs, 3D imaging)
Strong commitment to proper safety precautions in design and practice
Strong understanding of Lean concepts.
Excellent interpersonal and influencing skills to interact with other departments.
Ability to multi-task and perform in a dynamic environment
Strong sense of urgency, accountability and highly objective oriented
Highly organized and efficient in approaching tasks, a self-starter with the ability to problem solve proactively
Clear, concise, and articulate communication skills - verbal, written and listening
Strong team player, work ethic and commitment to win right
Strong analytical skills, ability to think big, act small and scale fast
Demonstrated experience in successfully achieving machining startups.
Proven experience developing/starting new manufacturing processes
Demonstrated experience improving productivity by machining optimization
Demonstrated experience improving OEE. And proven reduction in unplanned maintenance hours
Demonstrated experience utilizing Advanced Product Quality Planning Methodology and the integrated product and process development techniques within it. (E.g., Process Flow Diagrams, PFMEA, Control Plans, I/PPAP, Standard Work).
Proven success managing medium and large-scale projects from concept development through successful implementation.

cond_0114.intro: Reporting directly to the [Company name masked] Director Advanced Manufacturing Machining, the Advanced Manufacturing Machining Engineer is responsible for executing the manufacturing roadmap for optimizing machining processes, proper use of the equipment, design specifications, setup reviews, and new control strategies. The role is responsible for leading and ensuring that new equipment purchases are specified, sourced, qualified, and properly transitioned into mass production, meeting [Company name masked] and customer requirements and timing.
cond_0114.responsibilities:
Support and partner with OpCo's for improving OEE through initiatives such as SMED, TPM, etc. For new and existing equipment.
Work on [Company name masked] corporate strategy to work with OpCo's to drive productivity by internalizing spend (Buy2Make) on new capex and on existing equipment by maximizing machine utilization.
Lead SMED Events - Lead Site CNC technology Assessments – actively connect with site teams to project manage improvement activities.
Support and partner with OpCo's on their maturity journey for Machining Excellence Playbook. Provide technical development and deployment for new technologies related to machining to drive productivity improvements.
Drive and support machining strategy on productivity improvement by maximizing asset utilization.
Assist in the evolution of the equipment and perform acceptance evaluation accordingly.
Identify, recommend, procure, and install machine shop equipment as well as ensure all equipment is thoroughly maintained and calibrated.
Support workforce utilization, space requirements, workflow and designs layout of equipment and workspace for maximum efficiency.
Continuously improve and provide recommendations on upgrade of equipment to maximize asset utilization.
Stay in regular contact with tooling suppliers to ensure use of proper tooling for production. Work with suppliers to develop better cutting tools for specific PM applications.
Develop machining capability in-house while making changes to enhance machine functionality.
Identify, develop, and deploy new machining methods (or refine existing) to improve quality, reduce cost, and optimize build schedule.
Utilize lean manufacturing methodology for process development and problem solving.
Perform root cause analyses when non-conformances are identified and deploy corrective actions.
Help and support manufacturing to achieve safety, quality, efficiency and throughput goals, identifying opportunities to improve.
Apply Project Management skills and tools to lead and support capital equipment/improvement projects.
Investigate equipment performance and identify any problems for corrective actions and solutions.
Write/revise User Requirement Specs, Functional Requirements, Design Specs, Qualifications, etc.
Support Factory and Site Acceptance Tests, Machinability Studies, and validation protocols.
Review and approve PFMEA, DFMEA, PPAPs, and Standard Operating Procedures and ensure that manufacturing and operations comply with them.
Utilize continuous improvement methodology to improve internal processes.
Actively engage across the whole organization to identify issues, initiate discussions, and implement improvements.
Hands-on support of new product and new process launch.
Handle multiple projects and multiple priorities simultaneously.
[Location masked] travel 40-50% may be required.
Ability to perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0114.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in mechanical, electrical or manufacturing engineering, industrial technology, or equivalent mix of education and experience.
Minimum five (5) years' experience in manufacturing engineering directly working with machining processes.
Experience setting up and operating state of the art machining equipment.
Extensive experience in machining and maintenance.
Well versed in standard machine shop manufacturing processes and set ups.
Strong commitment to proper safety precautions in design and practice.
Strong understanding of Lean concepts.
Clear, concise, and articulate communication skills - verbal, written and listening.
Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to engage and work across departments.
Demonstrated experience in successfully achieving machining startups.
Proven experience developing/starting new manufacturing processes.
Demonstrated experience improving productivity by machining optimization.
Demonstrated experience improving OEE and proven reduction in unplanned maintenance hours.
Preferred Requirements
Strong experience with SolidWorks or another mechanical CAD system.
Highly experienced with a variety of precision conventional and advanced metrology systems (photogrammetry, CMMs, 3D imaging).
Ability to multi-task and perform in a dynamic environment.
Strong sense of urgency, accountability and objective orientation.
Highly organized and efficient in approaching tasks, a self-starter with the ability to problem solve proactively.
Strong team player, work ethic and commitment to win right.
Strong analytical skills, ability to think big, act small and scale fast.
Demonstrated experience utilizing Advanced Product Quality Planning Methodology and the integrated product and process development techniques within it (e.g., Process Flow Diagrams, PFMEA, Control Plans, I/PPAP, Standard Work).
Proven success managing medium and large-scale projects from concept development through successful implementation.

cond_0135.intro: Reporting to the [Company name masked] Director of Advanced Manufacturing Machining, the Advanced Manufacturing Machining Engineer works with operating companies and cross-functional teams to support and execute the manufacturing roadmap. This includes coordinating on machining process optimization, equipment use, design specifications, setup reviews, and new control strategies. The role also involves working with others to ensure new equipment purchases are specified, sourced, qualified, and properly transitioned into mass production, meeting [Company name masked] and customer requirements and timing.
cond_0135.responsibilities:
Support and coordinate with OpCo's to improve OEE through initiatives such as SMED, TPM, etc. For new and existing equipment.
Work alongside OpCo's on corporate strategy to help drive productivity by internalizing spend (Buy2Make) on new capex and on existing equipment by maximizing machine utilization.
Coordinate SMED Events and Site CNC technology Assessments – work with site teams to manage improvement activities.
Partner with OpCo's to support their maturity journey for the Machining Excellence Playbook. Provide technical development and deployment for new technologies related to machining to help drive productivity improvements.
Collaborate on machining strategy for productivity improvement by maximizing asset utilization.
Assist in the evolution of equipment and perform acceptance evaluations accordingly.
Work with the team to identify, recommend, procure, and install machine shop equipment, and help ensure all equipment is thoroughly maintained and calibrated.
Support workforce utilization, space requirements, workflow, and layout design of equipment and workspace for maximum efficiency.
Share recommendations on equipment upgrades to maximize asset utilization.
Coordinate with tooling suppliers to ensure use of proper tooling for production. Work with suppliers to develop better cutting tools for specific PM applications.
Help develop machining capability in-house while working with others to enhance machine functionality.
Identify, develop, and deploy new machining methods (or refine existing) in coordination with the team to improve quality, reduce cost, and optimize build schedule.
Apply lean manufacturing methodology together with the team for process development and problem solving.
Perform root cause analyses when non-conformances are identified and coordinate corrective actions.
Work alongside manufacturing teams to achieve safety, quality, efficiency, and throughput goals, and help identify opportunities to improve.
Apply project management skills and tools to coordinate and support capital equipment and improvement projects.
Investigate equipment performance and work with relevant teams to identify problems and implement corrective actions and solutions.
Write and revise User Requirement Specs, Functional Requirements, Design Specs, Qualifications, etc.
Support Factory and Site Acceptance Tests, Machinability Studies, and validation protocols.
Review and approve PFMEA, DFMEA, PPAPs, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and help ensure manufacturing and operations comply with them.
Apply continuous improvement methodology to improve internal processes.
Interact constructively across the organization to help identify issues and implement improvements.
Provide hands-on support for new product and new process launches.
Handle multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
Travel to [Location masked] 40–50% may be required.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Assist in the evolution of the equipment and performs acceptance evaluation accordingly
Identify, recommend, procure, and install machine shop equipment as well as ensure all equipment is thoroughly maintained and calibrated
Support work force utilization, space requirements, workflow and designs layout of equipment and workspace for maximum efficiency.
Continuously improve, provide recommendation on upgrade of equipment to maximize asset utilization.
Interface with tooling supplier to ensure use of proper tooling for production. Work with suppliers to develop better cutting tools for specific PM applications.

Utilize lean manufacturing methodology for process development and problem solving
Perform root cause analyses when non-conformances are identified and deploy corrective actions

Investigate equipment performance and identify any problems for corrective actions and solutions.

Hands-on support of new product and new process launch.
Must be able to handle multiple projects and multiple priorities simultaneously.
Ability to perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0181.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in mechanical, electrical or manufacturing engineering, industrial technology, or equivalent mix of education and experience.
Minimum five (5) years' experience of manufacturing engineering directly working with machining processes.
Experience setting up and operating state of the art machining equipment
Extensive experience in machining and maintenance.
Well versed in standard machine shop manufacturing processes and set ups
Strong commitment to proper safety precautions in design and practice
Strong understanding of Lean concepts.
Ability to multi-task and perform in a dynamic environment
Demonstrated experience in successfully achieving machining startups.
Proven experience developing/starting new manufacturing processes
Demonstrated experience improving productivity by machining optimization
Demonstrated experience improving OEE. And proven reduction in unplanned maintenance hours
Preferred Requirements
Strong experience with SolidWorks or another mechanical CAD system
Highly experienced with variety of precision conventional and advance metrology systems (photogrammetry, CMMs, 3D imaging)
Excellent interpersonal and influencing skills to interact with other departments.
Strong sense of urgency, accountability and highly objective oriented
Highly organized and efficient in approaching tasks, a self-starter with the ability to problem solve proactively
Clear, concise, and articulate communication skills - verbal, written and listening

Write/revise User Requirement Specs, Functional Requirements, Design Specs, Qualifications, etc.

Review and approve PFMEA, DFMEA, PPAPs, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) and ensure manufacturing and operations comply with them.
Apply continuous improvement methodology to improve internal processes.

Manage multiple projects and multiple priorities simultaneously.
[Location masked] travel 40-50% may be required.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Bachelor's degree in mechanical, electrical, or manufacturing engineering, industrial technology, or equivalent mix of education and experience.

Experience setting up and operating state of the art machining equipment.
Extensive experience in machining and maintenance.
Well versed in standard machine shop manufacturing processes and setups.
Strong experience with SolidWorks or another mechanical CAD system.
Strong commitment to proper safety precautions in design and practice.
Strong understanding of Lean concepts.
Demonstrated experience in successfully achieving machining startups.

Highly experienced with a variety of precision conventional and advanced metrology systems (photogrammetry, CMMs, 3D imaging).

This role leads and ensures that new equipment purchases are specified, sourced, qualified, and properly transitioned into mass production, meeting [Company name masked] and customer requirements and timing.
cond_0224.responsibilities:
Support and partner with OpCo's for improving OEE through initiatives such as SMED, TPM, etc. For new and existing equipment.
Execute [Company name masked] corporate strategy to drive productivity by internalizing spend (Buy2Make) on new capex and on existing equipment by maximizing machine utilization.
Lead SMED Events - Lead Site CNC technology Assessments – Project Manage Site improvement activities.
Drive OpCo's maturity journey for Machining Excellence Playbook. Deliver technical development and deployment for new technologies related to machining to drive productivity improvements.
Own machining strategy on productivity improvement by maximizing asset utilization.
Direct the evolution of equipment and perform acceptance evaluations accordingly.
Identify, recommend, procure, and install machine shop equipment and ensure all equipment is thoroughly maintained and calibrated.
Direct workforce utilization, space requirements, workflow, and layout of equipment and workspace for maximum efficiency.
Continuously improve and determine recommendations on equipment upgrades to maximize asset utilization.
Lead coordination with tooling suppliers to ensure use of proper tooling for production. Work with suppliers to develop better cutting tools for specific PM applications.
Build machining capability in-house while making changes to enhance machine functionality.
Identify, develop, and deploy new machining methods (or refine existing) to improve quality, reduce cost, and optimize build schedule.
Apply lean manufacturing methodology for process development and problem solving.
Perform root cause analyses when non-conformances are identified and deploy corrective actions.
Drive manufacturing to achieve safety, quality, efficiency, and throughput goals, identifying and acting on opportunities to improve.
Apply Project Management skills and tools to lead and deliver capital equipment/improvement projects.
Investigate equipment performance and determine corrective actions and solutions for any problems identified.
Write/revise User Requirement Specs, Functional Requirements, Design Specs, Qualifications, etc.
Execute Factory and Site Acceptance Tests, Machinability Studies, and validation protocols.
Review and approve PFMEA, DFMEA, PPAPs, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) and ensure manufacturing and operations comply with them.
Apply continuous improvement methodology to improve internal processes.
Engage constructively across the whole organization to identify issues and implement improvements.
Take ownership of new product and new process launch.
Manage multiple projects and multiple priorities simultaneously.
[Location masked] travel 40-50% may be required.
Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0224.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in mechanical, electrical, or manufacturing engineering, industrial technology, or equivalent mix of education and experience.
Minimum five (5) years' experience in manufacturing engineering directly working with machining processes.
Experience setting up and operating state of the art machining equipment.
Extensive experience in machining and maintenance.
Well versed in standard machine shop manufacturing processes and setups.
Strong experience with SolidWorks or another mechanical CAD system.
Strong commitment to proper safety precautions in design and practice.
Strong understanding of Lean concepts.
Demonstrated experience in successfully achieving machining startups.
Proven experience developing/starting new manufacturing processes.
Demonstrated experience improving productivity by machining optimization.
Demonstrated experience improving OEE and proven reduction in unplanned maintenance hours.
Demonstrated experience utilizing Advanced Product Quality Planning Methodology and integrated product and process development techniques (e.g., Process Flow Diagrams, PFMEA, Control Plans, I/PPAP, Standard Work).
Proven success managing medium and large-scale projects from concept development through successful implementation.
Preferred Requirements
Highly experienced with a variety of precision conventional and advanced metrology systems (photogrammetry, CMMs, 3D imaging).
Excellent interpersonal and influencing skills to interact with other departments.
Ability to multi-task and perform in a dynamic environment.
Strong sense of urgency, accountability, and objective orientation.
Highly organized and efficient in approaching tasks, a self-starter with the ability to problem solve proactively.
Clear, concise, and articulate communication skills - verbal, written, and listening.
Strong team player, work ethic, and commitment to winning right.
Strong analytical skills, ability to think big, act small, and scale fast.

AMME is responsible to lead and ensure that new equipment purchases are specified, sourced, qualified, and properly transitioned into mass production, meeting [Company name masked] and customer requirements and timing.
cond_0282.responsibilities:
Support and partner with OpCo's for improving OEE through initiatives such as SMED, TPM, etc. For new and existing equipment.
Work on [Company name masked] corporate strategy to work with OpCo's to drive productivity by internalizing spend (Buy2Make) on new capex and on existing equipment by maximizing machine utilization.
Lead SMED Events - Lead Site CNC technology Assessments – Project Manage Site improvement activities
Support and partner with OpCo's to support on maturity journey for Machining Excellence Playbook. Provide technical development and deployment for new technologies related to machining to drive productivity improvements.
Drive and support machining strategy on productivity improvement by maximizing asset utilization.
Assist in the evolution of the equipment and performs acceptance evaluation accordingly
Identify, recommend, procure, and install machine shop equipment as well as ensure all equipment is thoroughly maintained and calibrated
Support work force utilization, space requirements, workflow and designs layout of equipment and workspace for maximum efficiency.
Continuously improve, provide recommendation on upgrade of equipment to maximize asset utilization.
Interface with tooling supplier to ensure use of proper tooling for production. Work with suppliers to develop better cutting tools for specific PM applications.
Develop machining capability in-house while making changes to enhance the machine functionality.
Identify, develop, and deploy new machining methods (or refine existing) to improve quality, reduce cost, and optimize build schedule
Utilize lean manufacturing methodology for process development and problem solving
Perform root cause analyses when non-conformances are identified and deploy corrective actions
Helping and supporting manufacturing, to achieve safety, quality, efficiency and throughput goals, identifying opportunities to improve.
Apply Project Management skills & tools to lead and support capital equipment/improvement projects.
Investigate equipment performance and identify any problems for corrective actions and solutions.
Writes/revises User Requirement Specs, Functional Requirement, Design Specs, Qualifications, etc.
Supports Factory and Site Acceptance Tests, Machinability Studies, and validation protocols.
Responsible for review and approve PFMEA, DFMEA, PPAPs, and Standard Operating Procedures SOP and ensure that manufacturing and operations comply with.
Utilize continuous improvement methodology to improve internal processes.
Must be able to interact constructively across the whole organization to identify issues and implement improvements.

Must be able to handle multiple projects and multiple priorities simultaneously.
[Location masked] travel 40-50% may be required
Ability to perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0282.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in mechanical, electrical or manufacturing engineering, industrial technology, or equivalent practical experience.
Around five (5) years of manufacturing engineering experience working directly with machining processes, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Some experience setting up and operating state of the art machining equipment.
Background in machining and maintenance.
Familiarity with standard machine shop manufacturing processes and set ups.
Working knowledge of SolidWorks or another mechanical CAD system.
Exposure to a variety of precision conventional and advanced metrology systems (photogrammetry, CMMs, 3D imaging).
Commitment to proper safety precautions in design and practice.
Working knowledge of Lean concepts.
Ability to communicate effectively and work constructively with other departments.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
A sense of accountability and goal orientation.
Organized approach to tasks, with a willingness to problem solve proactively.
Clear communication skills — verbal, written and listening.
A collaborative work style and strong work ethic.
Analytical thinking and ability to scale approaches to different situations.
Demonstrated experience in successfully achieving machining startups.
Experience developing or starting new manufacturing processes.
Experience improving productivity through machining optimization.
Experience improving OEE and contributing to reduction in unplanned maintenance hours.
Familiarity with Advanced Product Quality Planning Methodology and integrated product and process development techniques (e.g., Process Flow Diagrams, PFMEA, Control Plans, I/PPAP, Standard Work).

cond_0295.intro: Reporting to the [Company name masked] Director of Advanced Manufacturing Machining, the Advanced Manufacturing Machining Engineer is responsible for executing the manufacturing roadmap for optimizing machining processes, proper use of equipment, design specifications, setup reviews, and new control strategies. The role is responsible for ensuring that new equipment purchases are specified, sourced, qualified, and properly transitioned into mass production, meeting [Company name masked] and customer requirements and timing.
cond_0295.responsibilities:
Support OpCo's in improving OEE through initiatives such as SMED, TPM, etc. For new and existing equipment.
Contribute to corporate strategy to drive productivity by internalizing spend (Buy2Make) on new capex and on existing equipment by maximizing machine utilization.
Lead SMED Events, conduct site CNC technology assessments, and manage site improvement activities.
Support OpCo's on their maturity journey for the Machining Excellence Playbook. Provide technical input and deployment for new machining technologies to drive productivity improvements.
Support machining strategy on productivity improvement by maximizing asset utilization.
Assist in the evolution of equipment and perform acceptance evaluations accordingly.
Identify, recommend, procure, and install machine shop equipment; ensure all equipment is thoroughly maintained and calibrated.
Support workforce utilization, space requirements, workflow, and layout design of equipment and workspace for maximum efficiency.
Provide recommendations on equipment upgrades to maximize asset utilization.
Coordinate with tooling suppliers to ensure use of proper tooling for production. Work with suppliers to develop better cutting tools for specific PM applications.
Develop machining capability in-house while making changes to enhance machine functionality.
Identify, develop, and deploy new machining methods (or refine existing) to improve quality, reduce cost, and optimize build schedule.
Apply lean manufacturing methodology for process development and problem solving.
Perform root cause analyses when non-conformances are identified and deploy corrective actions.
Support manufacturing in achieving safety, quality, efficiency, and throughput goals; identify opportunities to improve.
Apply project management skills and tools to lead and support capital equipment and improvement projects.
Investigate equipment performance and identify problems for corrective actions and solutions.
Write and revise User Requirement Specs, Functional Requirements, Design Specs, Qualifications, etc.
Support Factory and Site Acceptance Tests, Machinability Studies, and validation protocols.
Review and approve PFMEA, DFMEA, PPAPs, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs); ensure manufacturing and operations comply with them.
Apply continuous improvement methodology to improve internal processes.
Coordinate across the organization as needed to identify issues and implement improvements.
Provide hands-on support for new product and new process launches.
Manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
Travel to [Location masked] 40–50% may be required.
Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0295.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in mechanical, electrical, or manufacturing engineering, industrial technology, or equivalent mix of education and experience.
Minimum five (5) years of manufacturing engineering experience working directly with machining processes.
Experience setting up and operating state-of-the-art machining equipment.
Extensive experience in machining and maintenance.
Well versed in standard machine shop manufacturing processes and setups.
Strong commitment to proper safety precautions in design and practice.
Strong understanding of Lean concepts.
Demonstrated experience in successfully achieving machining startups.
Proven experience developing or starting new manufacturing processes.
Demonstrated experience improving productivity through machining optimization.
Demonstrated experience improving OEE and proven reduction in unplanned maintenance hours.
Preferred Requirements
Strong experience with SolidWorks or another mechanical CAD system.
Experience with a variety of precision conventional and advanced metrology systems (photogrammetry, CMMs, 3D imaging).
Strong analytical skills with the ability to think through problems and scale solutions.
Clear, concise written communication and direct verbal reporting.
Organized and efficient in approaching tasks, with the ability to problem solve independently.
Demonstrated experience utilizing Advanced Product Quality Planning methodology and integrated product and process development techniques (e.g., Process Flow Diagrams, PFMEA, Control Plans, I/PPAP, Standard Work).
Proven success managing medium and large-scale projects from concept development through implementation.

cond_0302.intro: Reporting directly to the [Company name masked] Director Advanced Manufacturing Machining, the Advanced Manufacturing Machining Engineer is responsible for executing the manufacturing roadmap for optimizing machining processes, proper use of the equipment, design specifications, setup reviews, and new control strategies. The AMME is responsible to lead and ensure that new equipment purchases are specified, sourced, qualified, and properly transitioned into mass production, meeting [Company name masked] and customer requirements and timing. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with machining processes and manufacturing environments.
cond_0302.responsibilities:
Support and partner with OpCo's for improving OEE through initiatives such as SMED, TPM, etc. For new and existing equipment.
Work on [Company name masked] corporate strategy to work with OpCo's to drive productivity by internalizing spend (Buy2Make) on new capex and on existing equipment by maximizing machine utilization.
Lead SMED Events - Lead Site CNC technology Assessments – Project Manage Site improvement activities
Support and partner with OpCo's to support on maturity journey for Machining Excellence Playbook. Provide technical development and deployment for new technologies related to machining to drive productivity improvements.
Drive and support machining strategy on productivity improvement by maximizing asset utilization.
Assist in the evolution of the equipment and performs acceptance evaluation accordingly
Identify, recommend, procure, and install machine shop equipment as well as ensure all equipment is thoroughly maintained and calibrated
Support work force utilization, space requirements, workflow and designs layout of equipment and workspace for maximum efficiency.
Continuously improve, provide recommendation on upgrade of equipment to maximize asset utilization.
Interface with tooling supplier to ensure use of proper tooling for production. Work with suppliers to develop better cutting tools for specific PM applications.
Develop machining capability in-house while making changes to enhance the machine functionality.
Identify, develop, and deploy new machining methods (or refine existing) to improve quality, reduce cost, and optimize build schedule
Utilize lean manufacturing methodology for process development and problem solving
Perform root cause analyses when non-conformances are identified and deploy corrective actions
Helping and supporting manufacturing, to achieve safety, quality, efficiency and throughput goals, identifying opportunities to improve.
Apply Project Management skills & tools to lead and support capital equipment/improvement projects.
Investigate equipment performance and identify any problems for corrective actions and solutions.
Writes/revises User Requirement Specs, Functional Requirement, Design Specs, Qualifications, etc.
Supports Factory and Site Acceptance Tests, Machinability Studies, and validation protocols.
Responsible for review and approve PFMEA, DFMEA, PPAPs, and Standard Operating Procedures SOP and ensure that manufacturing and operations comply with.
Utilize continuous improvement methodology to improve internal processes.
Must be able to interact constructively across the whole organization to identify issues and implement improvements.
Hands-on support of new product and new process launch.
Must be able to handle multiple projects and multiple priorities simultaneously.
Ability to perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0302.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in mechanical, electrical or manufacturing engineering, industrial technology, or equivalent mix or education and experience.
Minimum five (5) years' experience of manufacturing engineering directly working with machining processes.
Experience setting up and operating state of the art machining equipment
Extensive experience in machining and maintenance.
Well versed in standard machine shop manufacturing processes and set ups
Strong experience with SolidWorks or another mechanical CAD system
Highly experienced with variety of precision conventional and advance metrology systems (photogrammetry, CMMs, 3D imaging)
Strong commitment to proper safety precautions in design and practice
Strong understanding of Lean concepts.
Excellent interpersonal and influencing skills to interact with other departments.
Ability to multi-task and perform in a dynamic environment
Strong sense of urgency, accountability and highly objective oriented
Highly organized and efficient in approaching tasks, a self-starter with the ability to problem solve proactively
Clear, concise, and articulate communication skills - verbal, written and listening
Strong team player, work ethic and commitment to win right
Strong analytical skills, ability to think big, act small and scale fast
Demonstrated experience in successfully achieving machining startups.
Proven experience developing/starting new manufacturing processes
Demonstrated experience improving productivity by machining optimization
Demonstrated experience improving OEE. And proven reduction in unplanned maintenance hours
Demonstrated experience utilizing Advanced Product Quality Planning Methodology and the integrated product and process development techniques within it. (E.g., Process Flow Diagrams, PFMEA, Control Plans, I/PPAP, Standard Work).
Proven success managing medium and large-scale projects from concept development through successful implementation.

Bachelor's degree in mechanical, electrical, or manufacturing engineering, industrial technology, or equivalent mix of education and experience.
Minimum five (5) years' experience in manufacturing engineering directly working with machining processes.
Experience setting up and operating state of the art machining equipment.
Extensive experience in machining and maintenance.
Well versed in standard machine shop manufacturing processes and setups.
Strong experience with SolidWorks or another mechanical CAD system.
Strong commitment to proper safety precautions in design and practice.
Strong understanding of Lean concepts.
Demonstrated experience in successfully achieving machining startups.
Proven experience developing/starting new manufacturing processes.

Proven success managing medium and large-scale projects from concept development through successful implementation.

Highly experienced with a variety of precision conventional and advanced metrology systems (photogrammetry, CMMs, 3D imaging).
Excellent interpersonal and influencing skills to interact with other departments.
Ability to multi-task and perform in a dynamic environment.
Strong sense of urgency, accountability, and objective orientation.
Highly organized and efficient in approaching tasks, a self-starter with the ability to problem solve proactively.
Clear, concise, and articulate communication skills - verbal, written, and listening.
Strong team player, work ethic, and commitment to winning right.
Strong analytical skills, ability to think big, act small, and scale fast.

cond_0351.intro: Reporting to the [Company name masked] Director of Advanced Manufacturing Machining, the Advanced Manufacturing Machining Engineer works with operating companies and cross-functional teams to support and execute the manufacturing roadmap. This includes coordinating on machining process optimization, equipment use, design specifications, setup reviews, and new control strategies. The role also involves working with others to ensure new equipment purchases are specified, sourced, qualified, and properly transitioned into mass production, meeting [Company name masked] and customer requirements and timing.
cond_0351.responsibilities:
Support and coordinate with OpCo's to improve OEE through initiatives such as SMED, TPM, etc. For new and existing equipment.
Work alongside OpCo's on corporate strategy to help drive productivity by internalizing spend (Buy2Make) on new capex and on existing equipment by maximizing machine utilization.
Coordinate SMED Events and Site CNC technology Assessments – work with site teams to manage improvement activities.
Partner with OpCo's to support their maturity journey for the Machining Excellence Playbook. Provide technical development and deployment for new technologies related to machining to help drive productivity improvements.
Collaborate on machining strategy for productivity improvement by maximizing asset utilization.
Assist in the evolution of equipment and perform acceptance evaluations accordingly.
Work with the team to identify, recommend, procure, and install machine shop equipment, and help ensure all equipment is thoroughly maintained and calibrated.
Support workforce utilization, space requirements, workflow, and layout design of equipment and workspace for maximum efficiency.
Share recommendations on equipment upgrades to maximize asset utilization.
Coordinate with tooling suppliers to ensure use of proper tooling for production. Work with suppliers to develop better cutting tools for specific PM applications.
Help develop machining capability in-house while working with others to enhance machine functionality.
Identify, develop, and deploy new machining methods (or refine existing) in coordination with the team to improve quality, reduce cost, and optimize build schedule.
Apply lean manufacturing methodology together with the team for process development and problem solving.
Perform root cause analyses when non-conformances are identified and coordinate corrective actions.
Work alongside manufacturing teams to achieve safety, quality, efficiency, and throughput goals, and help identify opportunities to improve.
Apply project management skills and tools to coordinate and support capital equipment and improvement projects.
Investigate equipment performance and work with relevant teams to identify problems and implement corrective actions and solutions.
Write and revise User Requirement Specs, Functional Requirements, Design Specs, Qualifications, etc.
Support Factory and Site Acceptance Tests, Machinability Studies, and validation protocols.
Review and approve PFMEA, DFMEA, PPAPs, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and help ensure manufacturing and operations comply with them.
Apply continuous improvement methodology to improve internal processes.
Interact constructively across the organization to help identify issues and implement improvements.
Provide hands-on support for new product and new process launches.
Handle multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
Travel to [Location masked] 40–50% may be required.
Perform other duties as assigned.

cond_0397.intro: Reporting directly to the [Company name masked] Director Advanced Manufacturing Machining, the Advanced Manufacturing Machining Engineer is responsible for executing the manufacturing roadmap for optimizing machining processes, proper use of the equipment, design specifications, setup reviews, and new control strategies. AMME is responsible to lead and ensure that new equipment purchases are specified, sourced, qualified, and properly transitioned into mass production, meeting [Company name masked] and customer requirements and timing.
cond_0397.responsibilities:
Support and partner with OpCo's for improving OEE through initiatives such as SMED, TPM, etc. For new and existing equipment.
Work on [Company name masked] corporate strategy to work with OpCo's to drive productivity by internalizing spend (Buy2Make) on new capex and on existing equipment by maximizing machine utilization.
Lead SMED Events - Lead Site CNC technology Assessments – Project Manage Site improvement activities
Support and partner with OpCo's to support on maturity journey for Machining Excellence Playbook. Provide technical development and deployment for new technologies related to machining to drive productivity improvements.
Drive and support machining strategy on productivity improvement by maximizing asset utilization.
Assist in the evolution of the equipment and performs acceptance evaluation accordingly
Identify, recommend, procure, and install machine shop equipment as well as ensure all equipment is thoroughly maintained and calibrated
Support work force utilization, space requirements, workflow and designs layout of equipment and workspace for maximum efficiency.
Continuously improve, provide recommendation on upgrade of equipment to maximize asset utilization.
Interface with tooling supplier to ensure use of proper tooling for production. Work with suppliers to develop better cutting tools for specific PM applications.
Develop machining capability in-house while making changes to enhance the machine functionality.
Identify, develop, and deploy new machining methods (or refine existing) to improve quality, reduce cost, and optimize build schedule
Utilize lean manufacturing methodology for process development and problem solving
Perform root cause analyses when non-conformances are identified and deploy corrective actions
Helping and supporting manufacturing, to achieve safety, quality, efficiency and throughput goals, identifying opportunities to improve.
Apply Project Management skills & tools to lead and support capital equipment/improvement projects.
Investigate equipment performance and identify any problems for corrective actions and solutions.
Writes/revises User Requirement Specs, Functional Requirement, Design Specs, Qualifications, etc.
Supports Factory and Site Acceptance Tests, Machinability Studies, and validation protocols.
Responsible for review and approve PFMEA, DFMEA, PPAPs, and Standard Operating Procedures SOP and ensure that manufacturing and operations comply with.
Utilize continuous improvement methodology to improve internal processes.
Must be able to interact constructively across the whole organization to identify issues and implement improvements.
Hands-on support of new product and new process launch.
Must be able to handle multiple projects and multiple priorities simultaneously.
Ability to perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0397.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in mechanical, electrical or manufacturing engineering, industrial technology, or equivalent mix of education and experience.
Minimum five (5) years' experience of manufacturing engineering directly working with machining processes.
Experience setting up and operating state of the art machining equipment
Extensive experience in machining and maintenance.
Well versed in standard machine shop manufacturing processes and set ups
Strong commitment to proper safety precautions in design and practice
Strong understanding of Lean concepts.
Ability to multi-task and perform in a dynamic environment
Demonstrated experience in successfully achieving machining startups.
Proven experience developing/starting new manufacturing processes
Demonstrated experience improving productivity by machining optimization
Demonstrated experience improving OEE. And proven reduction in unplanned maintenance hours
Preferred Requirements
Strong experience with SolidWorks or another mechanical CAD system
Highly experienced with variety of precision conventional and advance metrology systems (photogrammetry, CMMs, 3D imaging)
Excellent interpersonal and influencing skills to interact with other departments.
Strong sense of urgency, accountability and highly objective oriented
Highly organized and efficient in approaching tasks, a self-starter with the ability to problem solve proactively
Clear, concise, and articulate communication skills - verbal, written and listening
Strong team player, work ethic and commitment to win right
Strong analytical skills, ability to think big, act small and scale fast
Demonstrated experience utilizing Advanced Product Quality Planning Methodology and the integrated product and process development techniques within it. (E.g., Process Flow Diagrams, PFMEA, Control Plans, I/PPAP, Standard Work).
Proven success managing medium and large-scale projects from concept development through successful implementation.

cond_0397.values: We value achievement, high standards, and work that is carried out with real discipline. We believe strong organizations are defined by the quality of what they deliver.

Support and partner with OpCo's for improving OEE through initiatives such as SMED, TPM, etc. For new and existing equipment.
Work on corporate strategy to work with OpCo's to drive productivity by internalizing spend (Buy2Make) on new capex and on existing equipment by maximizing machine utilization.
Lead SMED Events - Lead Site CNC technology Assessments – Project Manage Site improvement activities
Support and partner with OpCo's to support on maturity journey for Machining Excellence Playbook. Provide technical development and deployment for new technologies related to machining to drive productivity improvements.
Drive and support machining strategy on productivity improvement by maximizing asset utilization.
Assist in the evolution of the equipment and performs acceptance evaluation accordingly
Identify, recommend, procure, and install machine shop equipment as well as ensure all equipment is thoroughly maintained and calibrated
Support work force utilization, space requirements, workflow and designs layout of equipment and workspace for maximum efficiency.
Continuously improve, provide recommendation on upgrade of equipment to maximize asset utilization.
Interface with tooling supplier to ensure use of proper tooling for production. Work with suppliers to develop better cutting tools for specific PM applications.
Develop machining capability in-house while making changes to enhance the machine functionality.
Identify, develop, and deploy new machining methods (or refine existing) to improve quality, reduce cost, and optimize build schedule
Utilize lean manufacturing methodology for process development and problem solving
Perform root cause analyses when non-conformances are identified and deploy corrective actions
Helping and supporting manufacturing, to achieve safety, quality, efficiency and throughput goals, identifying opportunities to improve.
Apply Project Management skills & tools to lead and support capital equipment/improvement projects.
Investigate equipment performance and identify any problems for corrective actions and solutions.
Writes/revises User Requirement Specs, Functional Requirement, Design Specs, Qualifications, etc.
Supports Factory and Site Acceptance Tests, Machinability Studies, and validation protocols.
Responsible for review and approve PFMEA, DFMEA, PPAPs, and Standard Operating Procedures SOP and ensure that manufacturing and operations comply with.
Utilize continuous improvement methodology to improve internal processes.
Must be able to interact constructively across the whole organization to identify issues and implement improvements.
Hands-on support of new product and new process launch.
Must be able to handle multiple projects and multiple priorities simultaneously.
Ability to perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0514.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in mechanical, electrical or manufacturing engineering, industrial technology, or equivalent mix or education and experience.
Minimum five (5) years' experience of manufacturing engineering directly working with machining processes.
Experience setting up and operating state of the art machining equipment
Extensive experience in machining and maintenance.
Well versed in standard machine shop manufacturing processes and set ups
Strong experience with SolidWorks or another mechanical CAD system
Highly experienced with variety of precision conventional and advance metrology systems (photogrammetry, CMMs, 3D imaging)
Strong commitment to proper safety precautions in design and practice
Strong understanding of Lean concepts.
Excellent interpersonal and influencing skills to interact with other departments.
Ability to multi-task and perform in a dynamic environment
Strong sense of urgency, accountability and highly objective oriented
Highly organized and efficient in approaching tasks, a self-starter with the ability to problem solve proactively
Clear, concise, and articulate communication skills - verbal, written and listening
Strong team player, work ethic and commitment to win right
Strong analytical skills, ability to think big, act small and scale fast
Demonstrated experience in successfully achieving machining startups.
Proven experience developing/starting new manufacturing processes
Demonstrated experience improving productivity by machining optimization
Demonstrated experience improving OEE. And proven reduction in unplanned maintenance hours
Demonstrated experience utilizing Advanced Product Quality Planning Methodology and the integrated product and process development techniques within it. (E.g., Process Flow Diagrams, PFMEA, Control Plans, I/PPAP, Standard Work).
Proven success managing medium and large-scale projects from concept development through successful implementation.
cond_0514.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0514.workplace_support: We aim to support employees across different life and career stages through development resources, workplace flexibility, and inclusive benefits that make it easier to grow, contribute, and stay well.

People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with machining processes and manufacturing environments.
cond_0536.responsibilities:
Support and partner with OpCo's for improving OEE through initiatives such as SMED, TPM, etc. For new and existing equipment.
Work on [Company name masked] corporate strategy to work with OpCo's to drive productivity by internalizing spend (Buy2Make) on new capex and on existing equipment by maximizing machine utilization.
Lead SMED Events - Lead Site CNC technology Assessments – Project Manage Site improvement activities
Support and partner with OpCo's to support on maturity journey for Machining Excellence Playbook. Provide technical development and deployment for new technologies related to machining to drive productivity improvements.
Drive and support machining strategy on productivity improvement by maximizing asset utilization.
Assist in the evolution of the equipment and performs acceptance evaluation accordingly
Identify, recommend, procure, and install machine shop equipment as well as ensure all equipment is thoroughly maintained and calibrated
Support work force utilization, space requirements, workflow and designs layout of equipment and workspace for maximum efficiency.
Continuously improve, provide recommendation on upgrade of equipment to maximize asset utilization.
Interface with tooling supplier to ensure use of proper tooling for production. Work with suppliers to develop better cutting tools for specific PM applications.
Develop machining capability in-house while making changes to enhance the machine functionality.
Identify, develop, and deploy new machining methods (or refine existing) to improve quality, reduce cost, and optimize build schedule
Utilize lean manufacturing methodology for process development and problem solving
Perform root cause analyses when non-conformances are identified and deploy corrective actions
Helping and supporting manufacturing, to achieve safety, quality, efficiency and throughput goals, identifying opportunities to improve.
Apply Project Management skills & tools to lead and support capital equipment/improvement projects.
Investigate equipment performance and identify any problems for corrective actions and solutions.
Writes/revises User Requirement Specs, Functional Requirement, Design Specs, Qualifications, etc.
Supports Factory and Site Acceptance Tests, Machinability Studies, and validation protocols.
Responsible for review and approve PFMEA, DFMEA, PPAPs, and Standard Operating Procedures SOP and ensure that manufacturing and operations comply with.
Utilize continuous improvement methodology to improve internal processes.
Must be able to interact constructively across the whole organization to identify issues and implement improvements.
Hands-on support of new product and new process launch.
Must be able to handle multiple projects and multiple priorities simultaneously.
Ability to perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0536.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in mechanical, electrical or manufacturing engineering, industrial technology, or equivalent mix or education and experience.
Minimum five (5) years' experience of manufacturing engineering directly working with machining processes.
Experience setting up and operating state of the art machining equipment
Extensive experience in machining and maintenance.
Well versed in standard machine shop manufacturing processes and set ups
Strong experience with SolidWorks or another mechanical CAD system
Highly experienced with variety of precision conventional and advance metrology systems (photogrammetry, CMMs, 3D imaging)
Strong commitment to proper safety precautions in design and practice
Strong understanding of Lean concepts.
Excellent interpersonal and influencing skills to interact with other departments.
Ability to multi-task and perform in a dynamic environment
Strong sense of urgency, accountability and highly objective oriented
Highly organized and efficient in approaching tasks, a self-starter with the ability to problem solve proactively
Clear, concise, and articulate communication skills - verbal, written and listening
Strong team player, work ethic and commitment to win right
Strong analytical skills, ability to think big, act small and scale fast
Demonstrated experience in successfully achieving machining startups.
Proven experience developing/starting new manufacturing processes
Demonstrated experience improving productivity by machining optimization
Demonstrated experience improving OEE. And proven reduction in unplanned maintenance hours
Demonstrated experience utilizing Advanced Product Quality Planning Methodology and the integrated product and process development techniques within it. (E.g., Process Flow Diagrams, PFMEA, Control Plans, I/PPAP, Standard Work).
Proven success managing medium and large-scale projects from concept development through successful implementation.

cond_0592.intro: Reporting to the [Company name masked] Director of Advanced Manufacturing Machining, the Advanced Manufacturing Machining Engineer is responsible for executing the manufacturing roadmap for optimizing machining processes, proper use of equipment, design specifications, setup reviews, and new control strategies. The role is responsible for ensuring that new equipment purchases are specified, sourced, qualified, and properly transitioned into mass production, meeting [Company name masked] and customer requirements and timing.
cond_0592.responsibilities:
Coordinate with OpCo's on improving OEE through initiatives such as SMED, TPM, etc. For new and existing equipment.
Support [Company name masked] corporate strategy to work with OpCo's to drive productivity by internalizing spend (Buy2Make) on new capex and on existing equipment by maximizing machine utilization.
Lead SMED Events, lead site CNC technology assessments, and project manage site improvement activities.
Coordinate with OpCo's to support their maturity journey for the Machining Excellence Playbook. Provide technical development and deployment for new technologies related to machining to drive productivity improvements.
Support machining strategy on productivity improvement by maximizing asset utilization.
Assist in the evolution of equipment and perform acceptance evaluations accordingly.
Identify, recommend, procure, and install machine shop equipment; ensure all equipment is thoroughly maintained and calibrated.
Support workforce utilization, space requirements, workflow, and design layout of equipment and workspace for maximum efficiency.
Provide recommendations on equipment upgrades to maximize asset utilization.
Coordinate with tooling suppliers to ensure use of proper tooling for production. Work with suppliers to develop better cutting tools for specific PM applications.
Develop machining capability in-house while making changes to enhance machine functionality.
Identify, develop, and deploy new machining methods (or refine existing) to improve quality, reduce cost, and optimize build schedule.
Apply lean manufacturing methodology for process development and problem solving.
Perform root cause analyses when non-conformances are identified and deploy corrective actions.
Support manufacturing in achieving safety, quality, efficiency, and throughput goals; identify opportunities to improve.
Apply project management skills and tools to lead and support capital equipment and improvement projects.
Investigate equipment performance and identify problems for corrective actions and solutions.
Write and revise User Requirement Specs, Functional Requirements, Design Specs, Qualifications, etc.
Support Factory and Site Acceptance Tests, Machinability Studies, and validation protocols.
Review and approve PFMEA, DFMEA, PPAPs, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs); ensure manufacturing and operations comply with them.
Apply continuous improvement methodology to improve internal processes.
Coordinate across the organization as needed to identify issues and implement improvements.
Provide hands-on support for new product and new process launches.
Manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
[Location masked] travel 40–50% may be required.
Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0592.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in mechanical, electrical, or manufacturing engineering, industrial technology, or equivalent mix of education and experience.
Minimum five (5) years of manufacturing engineering experience working directly with machining processes.
Experience setting up and operating state-of-the-art machining equipment.
Extensive experience in machining and maintenance.
Well versed in standard machine shop manufacturing processes and setups.
Strong experience with SolidWorks or another mechanical CAD system.
Experienced with a variety of precision conventional and advanced metrology systems (photogrammetry, CMMs, 3D imaging).
Strong commitment to proper safety precautions in design and practice.
Strong understanding of Lean concepts.
Strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting skills.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
Strong sense of urgency, accountability, and results orientation.
Organized and efficient in approaching tasks, with the ability to problem solve independently.
Strong analytical skills.
Demonstrated experience in successfully achieving machining startups.
Proven experience developing and starting new manufacturing processes.
Demonstrated experience improving productivity through machining optimization.
Demonstrated experience improving OEE and proven reduction in unplanned maintenance hours.
Demonstrated experience utilizing Advanced Product Quality Planning methodology and integrated product and process development techniques (e.g., Process Flow Diagrams, PFMEA, Control Plans, I/PPAP, Standard Work).
Proven success managing medium and large-scale projects from concept development through implementation.
